check_trf009_cross_model_imports: check a Python AST tree for TRF009 violations where modeling files import implementation code from another model package
review_modeling_file_imports: review modeling_*.py files for cross-model import violations that break model logic isolation
test_model_dir_detection: test the _model_dir_name and _known_model_dirs helpers used to identify the current and known model directories
summarize_trf009_rule: summarize the TRF009 lint rule that prevents modeling files from importing implementation code from other model packages
refactor_cross_model_imports: refactor a modeling file to remove imports from other model packages and keep model logic local
